title: TermAl's mirrored Engram source-basis type carries no git_tree, so TermAl can neither send nor read the tree Engram's applicability and measured_unchanged checks use
outcome: TermAl's mirrored Engram source-basis type carries no git_tree, so TermAl can neither send nor read the tree Engram's applicability and measured_unchanged checks use
acceptance: TermAl's mirror of Engram's source basis carries the optional git_tree field with Engram's exact wire form and semantics (present or absent), round-tripping real Engram producer output without loss

Where TermAl emits a source basis it reports exactly the tree the host recorded for that revision, or none when none was recorded, never a tree inferred from the current worktree; deterministic tests cover present, absent and mismatch-refused cases
Exact-input focused tests, the full five-stage gate and an independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding
